extra.reason: Edit UI shipped for both text-highlight comments and markup notes; verified in browser (desktop + mobile), persists across reload

Reproduced with a headless-browser drag from the Comments heading into the note composer (native selection spanned both); fixed by making non-editable sidebar chrome (heading, composer excerpt label) non-selectable via CSS user-select: none. Verified the same drag now selects nothing.

Root cause: the markup overlay's touch-action:none blocks native swipe-scroll over the entire poem body, leaving little escape room to scroll on mobile. Implemented the stakeholder's own 'ebook-style page forward' suggestion as fixed-position up/down buttons (bottom-right, only visible in markup mode) that scroll the window by ~75% of viewport height. Verified in headless browser at desktop and mobile widths: hidden in highlight mode, appears in markup mode, scrolls and returns to original position.

Added Workshop.location and Workshop.meetingTime fields, rendered as a general-info block on the workshop home page above the existing per-class tabs. Per-week 'lesson links' requirement is met by the existing Class N tab navigation — actual lesson content pages are separate MVP epic children (tktk-seb.4/5/6/7), not yet built, so tabs currently link to each week's poem list rather than lesson content. Location/meeting time seeded as explicit TBD placeholders (no real values available yet), same convention as the lorem-ipsum poem bodies. Bumped storage key to tktk:v13 since Workshop's shape changed. Verified in browser at desktop and mobile widths, no console errors.

Built the full scope: new Lesson/LessonSegment types, storage (getLessonForClass/saveLesson), and a /lessons/:classNumber route (LessonEditor.tsx) linked from the workshop home page per class. WYSIWYG editing via contentEditable + document.execCommand (bold/italic/underline/lists) with uncontrolled bodies synced from the DOM only on save/reorder to avoid fighting React for the cursor. Outline sidebar lists segment headings and scrolls to them. Reordering via Up/Down buttons (reliable everywhere) plus native HTML5 drag-and-drop as a mouse-only bonus, since iOS/iPadOS Safari doesn't support HTML5 DnD over touch and this app is explicitly touch-first. Auto-segmentation via a 'Paste & auto-segment' textarea that splits markdown-style '# Heading' text into segments. Seeded one real example lesson for Class 1; other classes render a clean empty state. Verified end-to-end in a headless browser: add/edit/reorder/delete segments, bold formatting, auto-segment import, save + reload persistence, empty state for lessons that don't exist yet, desktop and mobile layouts. No console errors. Bumped storage key to tktk:v14.

Added EmailListCleaner component (collapsible section on the workshop home page): paste a Gmail-style contact list, extracts/dedupes email addresses via regex (stripping display names and angle brackets), shows a count, and copies the cleaned list to the clipboard. Verified headlessly: dedup works, clipboard copy confirmed via navigator.clipboard.readText(). No new types/storage needed, purely client-side ephemeral state.

Added Lesson.openAt (ISO datetime) with a datetime-local input on the lesson editor and a status line ('Not yet visible — opens ...' / 'Open since ...'). Since there's no student view yet in this prototype (instructor-only per CLAUDE.md), this drives an instructor-facing status only, not real access gating — documented in a type comment. Surfaced on the workshop home page too when a lesson is scheduled in the future. Verified headlessly: set/persist across reload, correct status text for future vs past dates, home page reflects pending status. No console errors.

Added LessonSegment.kind ('content'|'assignment'), startAt/dueAt fields, and a per-segment Kind selector in the lesson editor. Assignment segments show start/due datetime-local inputs and a 'Add due date to calendar (.ics)' button that generates and downloads a real, valid .ics VEVENT client-side. Reminder emails are explicitly out of scope and noted in the UI ('not available in this prototype — no backend to send them') since there's no mail server. Verified headlessly: toggling kind shows/hides fields, downloaded .ics content is well-formed, kind/dates persist across reload.

Added Reading type, storage (getReadingsForClass/getReading/addReading/deleteReading with comment-cascade cleanup), and a ReadingsList component on the workshop home page: paste a link, auto-derive a display title from the URL (no backend to fetch real page metadata — noted in a type comment), list readings per class with delete. Verified headlessly: add-by-paste works, title heuristic works, list renders correctly, no console errors.

Built /readings/:readingId (ReadingFeedback.tsx) reusing the *exact same* Comment/Reply storage functions and CommentCard/ReplyThread components PoemFeedback uses — Reading.id is passed wherever Comment.poemId is expected, not a parallel system. Since a Reading has no local text body, comments are general/unanchored (start:0, end:0, excerpt:'General comment') rather than highlight-offset based. Also extracted the duplicated author-resolution logic from PoemFeedback into a shared lib/authors.ts (resolveAuthor), used by both pages now — concrete reuse, not just an architectural intent. Verified headlessly end-to-end: post/edit/delete comment, reply, persistence across reload, delete cascade, and confirmed no regression on PoemFeedback after the refactor.

Implemented a scoped slice of the 4 optional extras the stakeholder listed: (1) Polls — Poll/PollOption types, storage (addPoll/deletePoll/toggleVote, single-choice with un-vote), PollsList component per class with create-poll form and a live vote-percentage bar chart. (2) Office hours — OfficeHoursSlot type, storage, OfficeHoursList component (workshop-wide, collapsible); booking is instructor-assigned via a dropdown rather than self-serve, since this app has no student view yet — documented in a type/component comment, not silently faked. (3) Profile pages — extracted AuthorModal's content into a shared AuthorProfileContent component, added a real /students/:studentId route (StudentProfile.tsx) and a 'View full profile' link from the modal, so profiles are now permanent/linkable, not just a popover. (4) 'Comment threads for everything' — already satisfied by tktk-seb.10's generalized Comment/Reply reuse across Poems and Readings; no new work needed here. Verified headlessly: poll create/vote/un-vote with correct percentages, office hours add/book/persist, profile page via modal link and direct URL nav, 404 case for an unknown student, all persist across reload, desktop and mobile layouts, no console errors.

Added PromptStage type and LessonSegment.stages, a 'Writing prompt' kind option in the editor with per-stage text + duration, and a new PromptRunner component: displays the current stage large, a live mm:ss countdown, auto-advances to the next stage when the timer hits 0, plus manual Start/Pause/Reset/'Reveal next stage now' controls. Caught and fixed a staleness bug during verification: PromptRunner was mounting as soon as a stage existed (even while its wrapper was collapsed), so duration edits made afterward wouldn't reach its already-captured countdown state until Reset — fixed by only mounting it while explicitly toggled open (state-driven, not a native <details>), so it always mounts fresh with current data. Verified headlessly: stage add/edit/delete, timer countdown while running, manual reveal, reset, persistence across reload, and the staleness fix itself (edit duration while closed, reopen, confirm new value). No console errors.

Added ClassSession type (sparse, classNumber -> title) with storage (getClassTitle/setClassTitle — clearing back to empty removes the entry rather than storing blank). New /syllabus page lists all classes 1..totalClasses with an inline-editable title input (saves on blur) and a link into that class's lesson editor. The Class N tabs on the workshop home page are untouched, per the explicit ask. The custom title also surfaces as a caption on the workshop home page (for the selected class) and the lesson editor header, purely for context — editing only happens on the syllabus page. Verified headlessly: tabs stay 'Class N', title edits persist across reload, clearing a title removes the caption everywhere, syllabus and captions render correctly at mobile width (fixed a text-truncation issue found during mobile verification by stacking the title onto its own row below 480px). No console errors.
